description: This file defines the PlanarReflection class, responsible for creating and managing planar reflections in a water rendering system within Unity. It handles reflection camera creation, rendering, and shader interactions for water surface reflections.

classes.name: PlanarReflection
classes.description: Handles creating, updating, and rendering planar reflections on water surfaces in Unity.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the shared material from the WaterBase component attached to the game object.

methods.name: CreateReflectionCameraFor
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a reflection camera associated with a given camera, setting basic parameters.

methods.name: SetStandardCameraParameter
methods.description: Sets culling mask, background color, and disable the camera's update loop.

methods.name: CreateTextureFor
methods.description: Creates a render texture for the reflection camera based on the source camera's size.

methods.name: RenderHelpCameras
methods.description: Manages helper cameras for reflection rendering, ensuring each source camera has an associated reflection camera.

methods.name: WaterTileBeingRendered
methods.description: Assigns the reflection texture to the water material before rendering.

methods.name: OnEnable
methods.description: Enables reflection shader keyword, indicating the water is reflective.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Disables the reflection shader keyword, reverting to simple water rendering.

methods.name: RenderReflectionFor
methods.description: Performs the rendering of water reflection for a camera, including setting up clip planes and camera matrices.

methods.name: SaneCameraSettings
methods.description: Configures helper camera to avoid unnecessary effects.

methods.name: CalculateObliqueMatrix
methods.description: Calculates a projection matrix with an oblique near-plane for reflection clipping.

methods.name: CalculateReflectionMatrix
methods.description: Generates a reflection matrix based on the reflection plane.

methods.name: Sgn
methods.description: Returns the sign of a float value.

methods.name: CameraSpacePlane
methods.description: Computes the camera space plane equation for reflection clipping.
